units.text: EXT. PIGEON LOFT - ROOFTOP - EVENING
A rickety wooden coop on a tenement roof.
Wire mesh.
Birds shifting and cooing.
Laundry lines snap in the wind.
Behind it, a skyline washed orange.
AUGUSTINE "AUGIE" MBEKI (70s, flat cap, hands gnarled as roots) kneels at the coop door feeding corn from a coffee can.
TOMASZ "TOMMY" NOWAK (40s, his son-in-law, hospital badge still clipped on) stands behind him, jacket slung over a shoulder.
Beside the water trough, ZUZANNA "ZUZU" NOWAK (12, Tommy's daughter, school uniform, backpack at her feet) holds a gray pigeon against her chest.
NADEEM ABBASI (30s, neighbor, tool belt) leans on the stairwell door frame with a beer.
Augie, we have to talk about Friday.
units.name: TOMMY

units.text: Nothing to talk about.
units.name: AUGIE

units.text: The building's being sold.
units.name: TOMMY

units.text: I know what the building is.
units.name: AUGIE

units.text: Council gave the tenants sixty days.
units.name: NADEEM

units.text: Nadeem. Drink your beer.
units.name: AUGIE

units.text: I'm only saying.
units.name: NADEEM

units.text: Grandpa, what happens to the birds?
units.name: ZUZU

units.text: Augie tips the last corn from the can.
He closes the coop door with a soft click.
They fly home.
units.name: AUGIE

units.text: But home is here.
units.name: ZUZU

units.text: Then they'll come back and find the roof empty.
units.name: AUGIE

units.text: Silence.
Tommy puts a hand on Augie's shoulder.
Augie does not shrug it off.
We'll find another roof.
units.name: TOMMY

units.text: Where? In Queens? They'd never find their way.
units.name: AUGIE

units.text: Augie, they've done it before. You said so.
units.name: NADEEM

units.text: Mm.
units.name: AUGIE

units.text: Zuzu lifts the pigeon high.
It flaps once, twice, and lifts out of her hands into the orange sky.
They all watch.
It circles the roof.
Settles on the antenna.
Grandpa. Look.
units.name: ZUZU

units.text: Augie nods slowly.
He tilts his cap back.
That one's called Hope. Your grandmother named her.
units.name: AUGIE
